groups.label: Audience and message
groups.description: Who you want to reach here and what you will tell them.

groups.label: Rules and requirements
groups.description: What this place allows and what it asks of you before you take part.

groups.label: Results
groups.description: What happened after it went live. Empty means not measured; 0 means you checked and there was none.

groups.label: Effort and cost
groups.description: The time and money this target took.

groups.label: Contact
groups.description: The person you deal with here and where the conversation stands.

groups.label: Timing
groups.description: When to publish and when it actually went out.

groups.label: Learning
groups.description: What to keep and what to change next time.

fields.label: Audience
fields.description: The people you want to reach here, described the way they would describe themselves. Naming one audience per target keeps the message specific.
fields.example: e.g. Solo founders who sell online

fields.label: Problem
fields.description: The problem or need you lead with, in the audience's own words rather than your feature names.
fields.example: e.g. Chasing unpaid invoices takes too long

fields.label: Angle
fields.description: The one point you lead with here, for example a result a customer got. Record it per target so you can see later which angle drew the best response.
fields.example: e.g. Saves two hours a week on invoicing

fields.label: Language
fields.description: The language of the audience and of what you publish here.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Where the audience is, or Global. It tells you when to post and where your results come from.

fields.label: Format
fields.description: The main form of what you publish or do here, so you can compare results by format.

options.label: Post
options.description: A short post or thread on a social network or forum.

options.label: Article
options.description: A longer written piece, such as a blog post, guest article, case study or press piece.

options.label: Video
options.description: A video, short clip, live stream or recorded demo.

options.label: Listing
options.description: An entry on a directory, marketplace, app store, launch platform or comparison site.

options.label: Talk
options.description: A talk, panel, webinar, podcast or live demo where you speak to an audience.

options.label: Email
options.description: A newsletter issue or a one-to-one email.

options.label: Ad
options.description: A paid ad or sponsored placement.

options.label: Other
options.description: Anything that does not fit the formats above.

fields.label: Rules
fields.description: The rules that affect you here, in your own words, with where you read them. Check them again before each post, since they can change.
fields.example: e.g. Self-promotion only in the Friday thread

fields.label: Self-promotion allowed
fields.description: Whether the rules let you post about your own product here. Leave it at unknown until you have read the rules or asked a moderator.

fields.label: Account needed
fields.description: Whether you need an account, or one with some history, before you can post or apply. If you do, create it well before you need it.

fields.label: Participation cost
fields.description: What the place charges to take part, such as a listing fee or a sponsorship package. Enter 0 once you have confirmed it is free.

fields.label: Published URL
fields.description: The address of the post, article, listing or recording once it is live, so you can go back and read the results.

fields.label: Reach
fields.description: How many people saw it, as the views or impressions the platform reports. Say in Result notes which measure you used.

fields.label: Engagement
fields.description: Reactions added together, such as likes, comments, shares, replies and upvotes. It shows whether people cared, even when few of them clicked.

fields.label: Clicks
fields.description: Visits to your site that came from this target. A tagged link makes them much easier to count.

fields.label: Conversions
fields.description: People who did what you wanted because of this target, such as signing up, installing, booking a call or buying. Say in Result notes which action you counted.

fields.label: Sentiment
fields.description: The overall tone of the reactions, judged from comments and replies.

options.label: Positive
options.description: Mostly supportive or interested.

options.label: Mixed
options.description: Strong support and strong criticism side by side.

options.label: Neutral
options.description: Polite or factual reactions with no clear lean.

options.label: Negative
options.description: Mostly critical or dismissive.

fields.label: Result notes
fields.description: What the numbers do not show: notable comments, who got in touch, which measure you used and when you counted.
fields.example: e.g. Counted after 3 days; two agencies asked for a demo

fields.label: Effort (hours)
fields.description: Hours spent preparing and doing this, start to finish; an estimate is fine. Next to the results, it shows which channels are worth your time.

fields.label: Cost
fields.description: All the money this target cost you, including fees, ads, freelancers and travel. Enter 0 when it cost nothing.

fields.label: Contact name
fields.description: The person you deal with here, such as an editor, organizer, moderator or host.

fields.label: Contact role
fields.description: Their role, so you know what they can decide.

fields.label: Contact channel
fields.description: How you reach them, so every follow-up goes to the same place.

options.label: Email
options.description: You write to them by email.

options.label: Direct message
options.description: A private message on a social network or chat app.

options.label: Form
options.description: A contact or submission form on their site.

options.label: Phone
options.description: A phone or video call.

options.label: In person
options.description: You meet them at an event or face to face.

fields.label: Last contact date
fields.description: The last day you wrote to them or heard back. Use it to time your next follow-up.

fields.label: Follow-ups sent
fields.description: How many follow-ups you have sent since the first message without a useful answer. Enter 0 when you have sent none yet.

fields.label: Response
fields.description: The latest answer to your outreach. The status still says where the target stands overall.

options.label: None
options.description: No answer yet.

options.label: Opened
options.description: They opened or read it but have not answered. Use it only when you can see this.

options.label: Replied
options.description: They answered, but nothing is decided yet.

options.label: Accepted
options.description: They said yes, for example to feature, publish, list or host you.

options.label: Declined
options.description: They said no.

fields.label: Best time
fields.description: When this audience is most active, in their time zone, based on your past results or the platform's own advice.
fields.example: e.g. Tue to Thu, 9:00 to 11:00 audience time

fields.label: Scheduled for
fields.description: When you plan to publish or go live. It can differ from the next action date, which may be for preparing it.

fields.label: Posted at
fields.description: When it actually went live. Next to the scheduled time and the results, it shows whether timing made a difference.

fields.label: What worked
fields.description: What you would do again, such as the wording, timing, format or people that worked. Read it before the next similar target.
fields.example: e.g. Opening with the customer story got the most replies

fields.label: Change next time
fields.description: What you would do differently next time, and why.
fields.example: e.g. Post earlier in the day and shorten the title
